ORRICK HALL | Internal operations bulletin
The sound cabinet contains two types of cables: green ties for cables that belong to the hall, and black ties for cables left by touring groups who have arranged to collect them. The color of a tie tells you who owns the cable. It does not tell you whether it works.
Put any cable with a damaged plug on the red inspection shelf, regardless of tie color. Do not reconnect it to confirm the fault. The inspection team attaches a white tag if a cable can be used again. That tag does not change ownership: leave the original tie attached.
On Thursday, the hall lends equipment to the library for a talk. The library has asked for two hall cables. Take green-tied cables from the regular cabinet or, if needed, from the inspection shelf only if they also have a white tag. Black-tied cables with white tags may be collected by their owners, but may not be lent to the library. For the library’s return, record the number of cables actually received; the loan list is not proof that both came back. Leave the cable bags unzipped at the duty desk so the staff on duty can check the plugs without unpacking each bag.

ORRICK 活動中心｜內部營運公告
音響設備櫃有兩類線材：中心自有線材綁綠色束帶；巡演團體留下並已安排領回的線材綁黑色束帶。束帶顏色只識別所有權，不表示線材能否使用。
不論束帶顏色，只要接頭損壞，就應放到紅色檢查架。不要重新接上線材來確認故障。檢查小組確認可重新使用時會掛上白色標籤。白標不代表所有權變更：請保留原本的束帶。
星期四中心會出借設備給圖書館辦講座。圖書館要借兩條中心自有線材。優先從一般設備櫃取有綠色束帶的線材；若有需要，也可到檢查架取有綠色束帶且掛白標的線材。有黑色束帶且掛白標的線材可由原所有者領回，但不可出借給圖書館。圖書館歸還時，要記錄實際收到的線材數量；借用清單不能證明兩條都已歸還。線材袋交到值班櫃檯時，請不要拉上拉鍊，讓值班人員不必逐袋拆開就能檢查接頭。
